classes.name: manifest
classes.reason: Each round is bracketed by barrier.wait() calls around the single _read_staged of class_a(workdir, r, placing), so every rank is held at the synchronisation point until that one file's open/fstat/pread completes, and each round uses a distinct file 'm%d' so a given rank reads a given class_a file exactly once.

classes.name: shard
classes.reason: The _read of class_b(workdir, me, i) happens after the barrier in the per-rank loop, so only the reading rank waits while other ranks read their own private files, and the same rank-owned file is re-read once in each of the cell.rounds=200 iterations.

classes.name: sidecar
classes.reason: class_c files are read synchronously via _read(class_c(workdir, me, i, placing)) in the post-barrier private loop indexed by the rank's own id, so only that rank blocks, and each of its files is read once per round for 200 rounds.
